meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: Claude 可通过 agent-browser 操作真实浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、提取页面信息,还能录屏、模拟鼠标键盘。
howto.when: 当用户要求访问网页、填写表单、截图、测试网页应用或从页面提取信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截个全页图
say.note: Claude 会打开页面并生成全页截图。

say.text: 帮我在这个页面上填表并提交
say.note: Claude 会先快照定位输入框,再填写并点击提交。

say.text: 提取当前页面里所有链接和标题
say.note: Claude 会读取页面元素并返回文本与属性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive a real browser via the agent-browser CLI: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text/HTML/data from pages, record videos, and simulate keyboard/mouse input.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to visit a website, interact with a web page, fill out forms, take screenshots, test a web application, or extract information from web pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and captures a full-page screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in this form and submit it for me.
say_en.note: Claude locates inputs from a snapshot, fills them, and clicks submit.

say_en.text: Extract all links and the title from the current page.
say_en.note: Claude reads page elements and returns text and attributes.
